pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #5 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the apostrophe in nǚ'ér do? (1 mark)
   A. It changes the tone
   B. It shows where one syllable ends and the next starts
   C. It means a light tone
   D. It marks a question

2. Which Chinese word means "love"? (1 mark)
   A. 爱 ài
   B. 有 yǒu
   C. 谁 shéi
   D. 姐姐 jiějie

3. Fill the blank: 电视在桌子上____? (Is the television on the table?) (1 mark)
   A. 了
   B. 的
   C. 呢
   D. 吗

4. What does 东西 (dōngxi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Door
   B. Sofa
   C. Things
   D. Toilet

5. What does 星期三 (xīngqīsān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Wednesday
   B. Today
   C. One
   D. Tomorrow

6. What does 一 (yī) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Eight
   B. Three
   C. Ten
   D. One

7. Which sentence means "My friend gives me a gift."? (1 mark)
   A. 祝你生日快乐!
   B. 朋友送我礼物。
   C. 我们切蛋糕。
   D. 我的生日是三月五号。

8. What does 大家 (dàjiā) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Month
   B. Everybody
   C. They
   D. We

9. What does 不 bù mean in 我不喜欢咖啡? (1 mark)
   A. Not
   B. Very
   C. And
   D. Also

10. Which sentence means "I like to eat bananas."? (1 mark)
   A. 这是什么?
   B. 我喝茶。
   C. 我喜欢吃香蕉。
   D. 这是香蕉。

11. Read the pinyin: wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. I use my eyes to see.
   B. I use my ears to hear.
   C. I have two eyes.
   D. I use my mouth to speak.

12. Which Chinese word means "knee"? (1 mark)
   A. 耳朵 ěrduo
   B. 膝盖 xīgài
   C. 刷牙 shuāyá
   D. 脚 jiǎo

13. What does 太阳 (tàiyáng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Sun
   B. Drought
   C. Weather
   D. Not

14. Which Chinese word means "not"? (1 mark)
   A. 很 hěn
   B. 不 bù
   C. 也 yě
   D. 干旱 gānhàn

15. What does 下面 (xiàmiàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Table
   B. Bathroom
   C. Below
   D. Fridge

16. Read the pinyin: huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The garden is on the right of the house.
   B. There is a bed in the bedroom.
   C. The fridge is in the kitchen.
   D. Where is the sofa?

17. Which Chinese word means "to be called"? (1 mark)
   A. 叫 jiào
   B. 谢谢 xièxie
   C. 您好 nín hǎo
   D. 再见 zàijiàn

18. How many strokes does 好 have? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 4
   C. 9
   D. 7

19. Which part is common to the characters 妈, 姐 and 妹? (1 mark)
   A. 马
   B. 未
   C. 且
   D. 女

20. What does 女儿 (nǚ'ér) mean? (1 mark)
   A. And
   B. Younger sister
   C. Daughter
   D. Is, am, are

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 说 and 再见. (2 marks)

22. Read and translate: 冰箱在厨房。 Then write the question that asks where the fridge is. (3 marks)

23. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The weather is very good today." (3 marks)

24. Write the Chinese for "I laugh" and "I cry" with pinyin. (2 marks)

25. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my older sister." (2 marks)

26. Explain how you can guess the meaning of 咖啡 in 我喝咖啡. (3 marks)

27. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "When is your birthday?" (3 marks)

28. Write a short paragraph in Chinese with pinyin that says there are four people in your family and names three of them. (5 marks)

29. Write the difference between a statement and a question when reading aloud, with an example. (3 marks)

30. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 放 and 蜡烛. (2 marks)

31. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: nǐ ne? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #5 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — It shows where one syllable ends and the next starts
   The apostrophe separates nǚ and ér.

2. A — 爱 ài
   爱 (ài) means love.

3. D — 吗
   吗 turns the statement into a yes-or-no question.

4. C — Things
   东西 (dōngxi) means things.

5. A — Wednesday
   星期三 (xīngqīsān) means Wednesday.

6. D — One
   一 (yī) means one.

7. B — 朋友送我礼物。
   朋友送我礼物。 (péngyou sòng wǒ lǐwù.) means "My friend gives me a gift.".

8. B — Everybody
   大家 (dàjiā) means everybody.

9. A — Not
   不 is not.

10. C — 我喜欢吃香蕉。
   我喜欢吃香蕉。 (wǒ xǐhuan chī xiāngjiāo.) means "I like to eat bananas.".

11. A — I use my eyes to see.
   wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn. is 我用眼睛看。, which means "I use my eyes to see.".

12. B — 膝盖 xīgài
   膝盖 (xīgài) means knee.

13. A — Sun
   太阳 (tàiyáng) means sun.

14. B — 不 bù
   不 (bù) means not.

15. C — Below
   下面 (xiàmiàn) means below.

16. A — The garden is on the right of the house.
   huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian. is 花园在房子右边。, which means "The garden is on the right of the house.".

17. A — 叫 jiào
   叫 (jiào) means to be called.

18. A — 6
   女 has 3 and 子 has 3.

19. D — 女
   女 means woman or female.

20. C — Daughter
   女儿 (nǚ'ér) means daughter.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: 说: shuō, to speak. 再见: zàijiàn, goodbye.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: bīngxiāng zài chúfáng. The fridge is in the kitchen. Question: 冰箱在哪儿?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for pinyin, 1 mark for translation, 1 mark for the question.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: 今天天气很好。 jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我笑 wǒ xiào; 我哭 wǒ kū.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是我姐姐。 zhè shì wǒ jiějie.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: The verb 喝 means to drink, so 咖啡 must be a drink. A picture can also help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the verb clue, 1 mark for the conclusion, 1 mark for another clue.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: 你生日是几月几号? nǐ shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

28. (5 marks)
   Answer: 我家有四口人。这是我爸爸,这是我妈妈,这是我。 wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén. zhè shì wǒ bàba, zhè shì wǒ māma, zhè shì wǒ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the family size sentence, 2 marks for three correct sentences, 1 mark for pinyin, 1 mark for punctuation.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: A statement ends a little lower, like 电视在客厅。 A question ends a little higher, like 电视在哪儿? Every syllable keeps its tone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each and 1 mark for keeping the tones.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: 放: fàng, to put. 蜡烛: làzhú, candle.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: And you?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.
